links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT-4V on USMLE-style image questions, and with history removed
links.effect: Accuracy 77.01% on USMLE-style questions; dropped to 19.54% when detailed patient history removed (P<0.0001); AUC 0.768 for chest radiograph abnormality detection.
links.quote: Removing detailed patient history dropped the diagnostic accuracy to 19.54% (P<0.0001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and image interpretation capabilities of ChatGPT-4V on benchmark datasets and exam questions (USMLE-style, ChestX-ray8, Diagnose Please cases) without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
